subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this auth migration fix land now as the focused doctor-owned preservation repair, or should maintainers require broader shipped-shape coverage first?
rationale: The patch fixes proven credential loss, but it changes upgrade-time handling of sensitive auth material and maintainers own the acceptable coverage bar for shipped legacy auth shapes.

options.title: Land after owner pass
options.body: Accept the focused fix after auth-migration owner review and exact-merge validation because the central data-loss path is proven and covered.

options.title: Add shipped-shape coverage first
options.body: Require one more regression fixture based on a known released auth file shape before merge if maintainers want lower upgrade risk.

options.title: Hold for consolidation
options.body: Pause only if maintainers decide this fix should be bundled with the separate runtime/import work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93352 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98245.

recommendation.title: Land after owner pass
recommendation.body: Accept the focused fix after auth-migration owner review and exact-merge validation because the central data-loss path is proven and covered.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-profile migration and doctor import surface trace back to the merged refactor authored by steipete.
